text: 法国央行发表声明，否认其在市场上出售了债务持仓，此前该央行遭到让-吕克·梅朗雄及其极左翼政党的批评。 该声明是对埃里克·科克雷尔言论的回应，后者称法国央行持有的证券投资组合出现了“令人担忧”的缩减。 法国央行表示，“自收购以来，这些证券均未在市场上出售”，并愿意向国民议会财政委员会解释其货币政策操作。
text_en: The Bank of France issued a statement denying that it had sold debt holdings in the market, after the central bank came under criticism from Jean-Luc Mélenchon and his far-left party. The statement was a response to remarks by Eric Coquerel, who said the securities portfolio held by the Bank of France had shrunk in a "worrying" way. The Bank of France said that "since acquisition, none of these securities have been sold on the market," and that it was willing to explain its monetary policy operations to the National Assembly's finance committee.
